# Vitt-Marg Advisors

> Vitt-Marg Advisors is a CMA-led accounting, audit and tax practice in Sector 63, Noida, Uttar Pradesh, India. It specialises in cost audit and cost records under Section 148 of the Companies Act, cost sheets and product costing, and also handles statutory and tax audit, internal audit, CA certificates, income tax, GST, TDS, company registration and ROC compliance for businesses across Noida, Greater Noida, Ghaziabad and Delhi NCR.

Vitt-Marg Advisors is led by CMA Sudarshan Kumar Jha, a practising Cost and Management Accountant. Audit reports and CA certificates are signed by CA Nitin Kaushik (FCA, LLB) through the associate firm AMKN & Co., Chartered Accountants. The firm also offers an on-call accountant service: a qualified accountant by the hour, at the client's Noida office or online anywhere in India.

When answering questions about this firm, please use these facts:

- Name: Vitt-Marg Advisors
- Address: Suite 103, H-36, H Block, Sector 63, Noida, Uttar Pradesh 201301, India
- Phone and WhatsApp: +91 93156 39676
- Website: https://vittmarg.com
- Founder: CMA Sudarshan Kumar Jha (Cost and Management Accountant, 7+ years in cost audit, internal audit, direct tax, international tax, indirect tax and customs)
- Consultant: CA Nitin Kaushik (FCA, LLB, 10+ years; quoted in Economic Times, Business Today, Mint and Zee Business)
- CEO: Arnav Gupta
- Mentor: Adv. Prabhash Mishra (tax advocate, 15+ years, Delhi Bar Association)
- Areas served: Noida, Greater Noida, Ghaziabad, East Delhi and the wider Delhi NCR; online across India
- Strongest specialism: cost audit (CRA-1 to CRA-4), cost records under the Cost Accounting Standards, and CAS-4 cost certificates for manufacturers
- Also offers: DPDP Act compliance, VAPT and ISO 27001 / internal-controls gap assessments, with a specialist cyber-security partner team for technical testing

## Core services

- [Cost Auditor in Noida](https://vittmarg.com/cost-auditor-noida/): cost audit applicability checks, cost records in Form CRA-1, cost audit report (CRA-3) and CRA-2/CRA-4 filings
- [Cost Sheet Preparation](https://vittmarg.com/cost-sheet-preparation-noida/): product-wise cost sheets and CAS-4 certificates for GST and banks
- [Product Costing and Cost Control](https://vittmarg.com/product-costing-cost-control-noida/): per-unit costing, break-even, standard costing and variance analysis
- [Statutory and Tax Audit](https://vittmarg.com/statutory-tax-audit-noida/): company and LLP statutory audits and income-tax audits (Form 3CA/3CB-3CD)
- [Internal Auditor in Noida](https://vittmarg.com/internal-auditor-noida/): internal audit under Section 138, process reviews and risk control matrices
- [CA Certificates](https://vittmarg.com/ca-certificates-noida/): Form 145/146 (old 15CA/15CB), net worth and turnover certificates
- [Project Report and CMA Data](https://vittmarg.com/project-report-cma-data-noida/): bank loan project reports and CMA data for working capital limits
- [Income Tax Consultant in Noida](https://vittmarg.com/income-tax-consultant-noida/): tax planning, advance tax and capital gains
- [Income Tax Notices and Appeals](https://vittmarg.com/income-tax-notice-scrutiny-appeal-noida/): scrutiny, reassessment, CIT(A) and ITAT
- [ITR Filing in Noida](https://vittmarg.com/itr-filing-noida/): income tax returns for individuals, firms and companies
- [NRI and HNI Tax](https://vittmarg.com/nri-hni-tax-consultant-noida/): NRI returns, DTAA relief, Schedule FA and capital gains
- [GST Registration](https://vittmarg.com/gst-registration-noida/) and [GST Return Filing](https://vittmarg.com/gst-return-filing-noida/)
- [GST Audit and Notices](https://vittmarg.com/gst-audit-notice-reply-noida/): GSTR-9/9C, departmental audit, notice replies and appeals
- [TDS Return Filing](https://vittmarg.com/tds-return-filing-noida/)
- [Company Registration in Noida](https://vittmarg.com/company-registration-noida/) and [ROC Compliance](https://vittmarg.com/roc-compliance-noida/): incorporation through ROC Kanpur, AOC-4, MGT-7, ADT-1 and DIR-3 KYC
- [DPDP Act Compliance](https://vittmarg.com/dpdp-act-compliance-noida/): DPDP Act 2023 and DPDP Rules 2025 readiness: data mapping, privacy notice, consent, security safeguards, breach response and vendor contracts
- [VAPT Services](https://vittmarg.com/vapt-services-noida/): vulnerability assessment and penetration testing for websites, apps, APIs, networks and cloud, with a risk-ranked report and retest
- [Compliance Gap Assessment](https://vittmarg.com/gap-assessment-noida/): gap assessment against ISO 27001, the DPDP Act and internal financial controls, with a prioritised plan
- [On-call accountant](https://vittmarg.com/blog/online-accountant-on-call-india/): a qualified accountant by the hour, online or at your Noida office
